## Thursday, November 12, 2026

### Skyliners Frankfurt vs. Maxima Roma (20:00 CET)

##### Klaus Perwas, Skyliners head coach

“Maxima is a top team with tremendous international experience and a high level of individual quality. Following Sunday's tough loss in Weißenfels, it will be particularly important for us to be mentally ready from the very start. We need to learn from the mistakes we've made over the past few days: offensively, we must avoid getting caught up in too many one-on-one situations, move the ball much better again and play as a team. If we can take care of the ball, control the pace ourselves and bring the necessary energy to the court with the support of our home fans, we have a real chance. It's a challenge in the EuroCup, but the team is hungry and eager to respond.”

##### Till Pape, Skyliners forward

“Maxima has the same record as we do. For the first time this season, we've lost two games in a row. This is our opportunity to stop this little losing streak and make up for the tough loss against the MBC. I think we've done a relatively good job this season of bouncing back after poor performances or tough losses. And I believe that's exactly our goal now. We want to play our style of basketball, and we want to win again. We know what it takes to win. Now it's about putting that into action on the court and showing up as a united team.”

##### Skyliners injury report

Race Thompson is ruled out for the game.

##### Matteo Cotelli, Maxima head coach

"We’re expecting a very challenging game, because Frankfurt is playing basketball at a very high level. They deserve a lot of respect for the way they’ve been performing in the EuroCup. For us, this is also the start of a three-game stretch on the road, so it will be very important to stay solid, stay together as a team and play with the highest possible level of energy."
## Wednesday, November 11, 2026

### Bahcesehir College Istanbul vs. Lietkabelis Panevezys (17:00 CET)

--



### Siauliai Basketball vs. La Laguna Tenerife (17:30 CET)

##### Darius Songaila, Siauliai head coach

"Jaka and I played together at Galatasaray, and lately he’s been showing he’s a good coach too. He knows his team very well, and they stand out with their discipline, the way they read the game and their experience. Huertas and Shermadini are in their eighth season together at the club, same with Doornekamp and Abromaitis – they know each other inside out."

##### Mike Caffey, Siauliai guard

"They have a legendary duo in Huertas and Shermadini, who have played together for a long time and know each other perfectly. We just have to play our game, not force anything and really focus on defence. It is a big game for our organisation, a big club is coming to town, so we need the fans to fill the arena."



### NINERS Chemnitz vs. Napoli Basketball (19:00 CET)

--



### Aris Thessaloniki vs. Riga Zelli (19:00 CET)

##### Vassilis Spanoulis, Aris head coach

“All teams are good and all teams can play basketball. If you don’t perform, you cannot beat anyone. Basketball has changed. Everyone is capable of competing, as we can see both at club and national team level. We respect our opponent. We will focus on doing the things we do well, putting in a good performance and getting the win. They are a team that plays physically, like all teams do. They also run the fast break very well. They are aggressive defensively and play with a lot of physical contact. Above all, we need to stick to our game, not allow their physical defensive approach to affect us, and focus more on rebounding.”

##### E. J. Liddell, Aris forward

“They come out and compete with great intensity. They got off to a slow start to the season, but then I think they won three games in a row. We just have to be ready to compete. We respect them as a team and as an organization.”

##### Rokas Kondratavicius, Zelli head coach

"We are facing Ares, the team with one of the deepest and most talented roster in the EuroCup. Also the team who has one of the toughest arenas to play in all Europe with very passionate fans so it will not be an easy task for us and if we want to reach the win out there first of all we need to be calm and concentrate to our game plan, don't get out of control because of the fans and the loudness that will be there and if we will stick to our game plan, if we will show energy and effort then we have a chance to give them a good fight and maybe a win for us."

##### Gustavs Kampuss, Zelli guard

"So, the feelings before the next EuroCup game are pretty nice, pretty good. Since it's going to be the first game that I'm going to participate, I'm not going to be from the bench where the injured players sit. So, that's going to be cool, a new experience. The mood is right, good. We all know that the games in Ares, in Greece, have great atmosphere. And it's different from the ones that I've experienced and the team has experienced. I feel very, very good about the upcoming EuroCup game."

### Baglietto Derthona Tortona vs. Hapoel Midtown Jerusalem (19:30 CET)

##### Mario Fioretti, Derthona head coach

"We want to build on Sunday’s \[Italian\] League game against Treviso by playing for 40 minutes with great focus and intensity. We are facing one of the four strongest teams in Europe outside of the EuroLeague, with a roster that is well-rounded in every position. We know how tough it will be, but we are approaching it with enthusiasm and a positive mindset."

##### Paul Eboua, Derthona center

"To win we will have to make fewer mistakes than Jerusalem, go all very aggressive on rebound, and in doing so, be able to make easy baskets in transition. On defense, we need to work well on the pick-and-roll, in low post, and communicate well with each other. To continue the improvements shown in last Italian League game, we need to stay focused and connected for the full 40 minutes, move the ball more, play together more, and, as mentioned before, try to run more to find easier baskets. All of this will give the right energy and pace to the team."

**Injuries**: All players are available for Derthona, including new arrival Christian Vital, the American guard who recently returned to the club.

##### Sasa Obradovic, Jerusalem head coach

“Derthona Basket is a very serious opponent. Their position in the standings doesn’t reflect their quality. They have been getting much better, and they have lost some games in the final moments, which also shows how good they are. Their last couple of games have shown that they can play really great basketball. They will be very physical. We will have to play a very good game to win. It’s important for us to keep our winning streak."

##### Jaleen Smith, Jerusalem guard

"Derthona is a really good team, and their record doesn’t reflect how good they actually are. They’re a very offense-oriented team, with four guards capable of scoring 20 points on any given night. So we must watch out for them, stay true to our defensive abilities, and try to stop them with our defense.”

### Roma Basketball vs. ratiopharm ulm (20:00 CET)

--

### Le Mans Sarthe Basket vs. Recoletas Salud San Pablo Burgos (20:00 CET)

##### Guillaume Vizade, Le Mans head coach

"Burgos are a typical Spanish league team: pace, speed and talent. We will need to be ready and fully in sync to rise to this new challenge in the EuroCup."

##### Melvin Ajinça, Le Mans forward

"We need to be prepared for any kind of scenario. They are a very talented team, so we will need to be solid defensively. On our end, we must stick to our identity and remain disciplined in executing the game plan set by the coach."

##### Porfi Fisac, Burgos head coach

"We come back to the EuroCup after not playing really well, to our true level, in the last game. We'll compete against a great, athletic team and one of the best defenses in the EuroCup, so for this reason it’s important for us to increase our mentality level.”

##### Retin Obasohan, Burgos guard

"I'm excited to play the first away game with the team and to play this road trip with the guys. And then for us as a team, I think it's really important for us to build on what we did on our last game, to take the good stretches from the game and to find a way to replicate that and build on that away from home. So we want to go in there and compete, play at a high level, play with high pace, share the ball, play tenacious on defense and go out there and compete, compete to win and compete to to to improve, improve as a team. There's a lot of basketball to be played, and we have to understand that every single opportunity that we get, every single game is an opportunity to not only win a game, but also to get better as a team. So with that, we have to go with full focus, respect the opponent because they're a very good team. They're playing a tough competition. But then also understand that you know, in order for us to be and become a better team, we have to go in there and give it everything we have because that'll help us in the long run."

**Injuries**: Burgos announced it will be without DJ Steward due to a hamstring injury suffered over the weekend in the Spanish League game.
## Tuesday, November 10, 2026

### Balkan Botevgrad vs. PAOK Thessaloniki (18:00 CET)

##### Andrea Trinchieri, PAOK head coach

“There is not a lot of time for thinking, there is only time to try to prepare and get ready. Many times we have played on Tuesday, so one day less of preparation, but it is what it is. If we do the mistake and look at their ranking, we will have a long night because they are newcomers in EuroCup. They just won a very tough game on the road in Sarajevo and there for example Bahcesehir lost. For example we won in the very end of the game. So it’s a tough team, they have nothing to lose and it will be a very physical game.”

##### Ben Moore, PAOK center

“I expect it to be a difficult game. First of all, we are going on the road but they are a good team they have good big guys which they have a lot of size and a couple more offensive weapons we got to be aware of. It is going to be a good game. We have to be in sync in offense, sharing the ball and getting everybody involved. Defensively we have to be locked in, pay attention to details and stay disciplined and solid in defense and of course rebound.”
### Neptunas Klaipeda vs. Slask Wroclaw (18:00 CET)

--

**Injuries:** Slask's Devin Robinson is traveling for the game. Błazej Kulikowski will not play due to a calf injury. John Egbunu remains unavailable due to a muscle injury. Jared Coleman-Jones has been registred for this game. 



### U-BT Cluj-Napoca vs. Turk Telekom Ankara (18:00 CET)

##### Mihai Silvasan, Cluj head coach

"The game against Turk Telekom gives us another opportunity to get out of this difficult period we are going through. I think we saw some very good things in the game against Bosna. We need to try to have more confidence in ourselves. That is what I am trying to instil in the players. It is not easy after such a difficult spell, but it is our only chance. We need to keep fighting and stay together because, honestly, I still believe this team has a lot of potential."

##### Uros Plavsic, Cluj center

"We know that we play against a really good team. A tough couple of games are behind us and we need to find the way to focus on what is ahead of us. Fix the mistakes we made in previous matches and try to execute better on both ends of the floor. I would like to thank our fan base for supporting us through these tough times and we will do everything in our power to give back to them by winning more games. Their support really means a lot."



### Cosea JL Bourg-en-Bresse vs. Buducnost VOLI Podgorica (19:30 CET)

##### Freddy Fauthoux, Bourg head coach

“This is a very important game because it’s the last of the first half of the group stage. With a win, we could move into the Top 4 and be level with Buducnost, so it’s going to be a very important game for what comes next. We’re going into it with ambition, we want to do well and hopefully we will. We know the start of the season has been difficult, so we’re taking things step by step. Today, we’re also back in our arena in front of our fans, and now we need to start picking up points.”

##### Tyger Campbell, Bourg guard

"As a team we’re happy to be back at home to play in front of our fans in the EuroCup. We know that Buducnost is a good team that plays a physical style of basketball so we have to come ready to compete and leave it all out on the court for 40 minutes." 

##### Andrej Zakelj, Buducnost head coach

"Bourg is always a tough opponent, especially when playing in front of their home fans. They are an athletic team that plays fast and likes to run. That will certainly be a challenge for us. They have had some injury problems, but as far as I know, a few players are returning. This game is very important for them, just as it is for us. We have to be focused and ready for what awaits us."

##### Iverson Molinar, Buducnost guard

"I feel good. The team has great momentum heading into the next EuroCup game, which is a really important one for us. I'm glad I was able to make some important plays down the stretch in the previous game. It's going to be a tough game against Bourg. It's always difficult to play against them on the road, especially in front of their home fans. We just have to be ready and give it everything we've got. Bourg is a quality team. They play fast and have very talented players at every position. We expect a really good matchup."



### Dolomiti Energia Trento vs. Tofas Bursa (20:00 CET)

##### Nazareno Lombardi, Trento assistant coach

“We face a team whose calling cards are physicality, intensity, and attitude primarily on defense, but on offense as well. We are called upon to put together a performance marked by high energy, focus, poise, and a relentless drive to compete on every possession, avoiding any prolonged lapses. We must stay aggressive play after play, both offensively and defensively, bringing real physicality and a willingness to help each other out in every situation. We cannot let their aggressiveness get the better of us or allow their ability to disrupt an opponent’s rhythm to take us out of our game. It’s going to be a tough matchup, but I’m confident the team will look to take another step forward in our continuous growth.”

##### Alessandro Bertini, Trento guard

“We face a tough test against a very experienced side, with many players who have spent years competing across European leagues. We need to build on the positives from our last two games against Napoli and Milan; we showed a strong reaction, we are continuing to improve, and tomorrow we have to be as tough as possible. Over our last two outings, I've seen real progress, especially in terms of consistency. We're cutting down on our mistakes and, most importantly, we've proved that we can stay in the game and never back down against top-tier opponents. Playing at home can give us a huge boost. We can't wait to take the floor in front of our crowd.”

**Injuries:** Patrick Hassan is out for Trento and Toto Forray is a game-time call.

##### Jovan Gorec, Tofas assistant coach

"This is important game in front of us and playing on the road and in EuroCup is never easy.  Trento have a good team, especially at home. They have a tough home court and we know that we need to be ready for a tough challenge. However, we have our own goals and ambitions and we want to stay focused and we know what we need to do. Our approach to this game will be 40 minutes of the right mentality, energy and discipline."

##### Bryce Jones, Tofas guard

"Looking forward to playing a good game against a good offensive team. We have to be together defensively, rebound and play our game. I think if we play it through our strengths, we'll have a great chance of winning the game. It's going to be tough. All road games are tough, so we've got to be mentally ready. We'll do our best to win the game. Looking forward to it and just getting the win."
### Rostock Seawolves vs. Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana (20:00 CET)

##### Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz, Rostock head coach

"With Ljubljana, a very balanced team is coming to face us. They have put together a very interesting roster. Their scoring is well distributed across the entire team. They have three guards, Anthony Cowan Jr., Jordan Gainey and Noah Kirkwood, who can all score. They have also signed interesting big men such as Matthew Hurt and David Skara, who are threats both from the perimeter and in the paint. We need to be focused from the opening tip and apply consistent defensive pressure to force mistakes and get out in transition. That has been a particular strength of ours in recent games."

##### Robin Amaize, Rostock forward

"The wins in the league and in the EuroCup have given us confidence recently. We want to bring that same energy as a team into Tuesday's home game against Olimpija Ljubljana in front of our fans. We are facing an opponent that earned its first win of the season last week. We cannot afford to underestimate them."

##### Zvezdan Mitrovic, Cedevita Olimpija head coach

“Rostock are in excellent rhythm at the moment. They have strung together three straight wins, including victories over Bayern and away at Burgos. They shoot a lot of threes and are very efficient doing it. Their style of play is extremely uncomfortable to face, as the Spanish team found out in their last game, when they lost by a big margin. Rostock plays fast and relies heavily on the three-point shot, including from positions that might seem illogical at first glance, but that is part of their system. Our task will be to slow down their pace, limit their fast game and deny them as many open threes as possible. We are coming off a demanding trip, so it is important that we rest as well as possible and prepare for the opponent. Rok Radovic and Rihards Lomazs are with us, and I expect both of them to return to the court. They certainly won’t be 100 percent ready yet, but their presence will mean a lot to us. We have put together some good performances in recent games, especially on defence, where we managed to limit the opponents’ top scorers. This time an even tougher task awaits us, so we will have to be very disciplined, focused and adapt well.”

##### Jordan Gainey, Cedevita Olimpija guard

“We have a demanding game ahead of us against a very good and versatile Rostock team. Our opponents play fast, like to run in transition and shoot a lot from distance. They are also very aggressive on defense and know how to take advantage of an opponent’s weaknesses. That is why we will have to be focused on both ends of the floor, stick to our game plan and, above all, limit their three-point shots. Our task is to show the fight and energy that have characterized us in recent games. We have three straight wins behind us and want to keep that rhythm going. We are focusing on one game at a time, while also wanting to improve day by day and put into practice on the court what we work on in training."



### Kids&Us Manresa vs. BOSNA BH Telecom Sarajevo (20:30 CET)

--



### London Lions vs. Umana Reyer Venice (20:30 CET)

##### Neven Spahija, Reyer head coach

"It will be a tough game. London is a team that plays very hard; they don’t put up huge numbers on the scoreboard, but they rely heavily on their defense and keep scores low. Backed by their home crowd on their own floor, it will undoubtedly be challenging. As always, having had only one day to prepare for the matchup, we are going there to play our brand of basketball and try to win. I expect exactly what I just highlighted: we must play with great defensive toughness, embrace physical contact, and control the defensive boards, which will be one of the most crucial keys to the game. Everyone is available, except for Olinde, who remains out of the rotation as a precautionary measure."

##### Jordan Parks, Reyer forward

"The main goal is to build on what we did in our last game: we want to take the momentum, energy, and positive feelings we have, carry them onto the floor, and come away with another win, no matter what it takes. From our side, I expect energy above all else. I think I've said it quite often in recent games: our intensity and body language impact every single thing we do on the court. We've already faced the London Lions in previous EuroCup seasons. They are always a tough, physical, and determined team, so we have to be ready for a real battle: they will make things difficult for us, and we definitely shouldn't expect anything to come easy."
